name: SVGO
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: SVG optimisation; preserve IDs needed by animation
summary: Node.js tool and library that optimises SVG by removing metadata, editor cruft and redundant attributes and by minifying paths. Run as the svgo CLI or from a script with a plugin config; output is smaller SVG. Its large plugin set is useful when configured carefully: preset-default cleanupIds can remove or rename IDs, while removeViewBox is a separate plugin and is not in the documented preset-default list.
use_when: Shrinking SVG exported from Inkscape, Figma or Illustrator before it enters a scene
Cleaning Graphviz or Mermaid SVG output in a pipeline
Normalising SVG before diffing or hashing
avoid_when: The SVG is animated by ID or class and the active config allows cleanupIds to rename or remove anchors
Rasterising only: resvg rasterises SVG without optimisation
Hand-authored minimal SVG that is already small

assessment.rationale: npm 4.1.0 published 2026-08-24, with 2.8.4 backported the same day; MIT. De facto SVG optimiser; no neighbour covers it. The ID-preservation caveat in the role is a real risk with default presets.

evidence.result: Optimized owned SVG from 462 B to 399 B (13.6% smaller); XML parsed; viewBox and motion-target ID preserved; repeat output byte-identical; raster inspection at 512 px showed the gradient and shape intact.
evidence.scope: One static SVG optimized by SVGO 4.0.1 on macOS arm64; preserves viewBox and selected ID with this config. Does not establish arbitrary SVG equivalence or browser animation.

notes: 2026-11-15: Official preset-default docs (https://svgo.dev/docs/preset-default/) list cleanupIds but not removeViewBox; the viewBox caveat in the older card wording did not apply to this SVGO 4.0.1 fixture.
